An '''electronics store''' whose [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] was a [[Unidentified Verpine (Poln Major)|Verpine]] was located in [[Whitestone City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the store to buy an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] toy and several electronic components.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The electronics store appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
